verdict.rationale: Restate documents fan-out/fan-in, where work is spread across multiple agents and the results combined, with failed branches retried independently (restate-docs-52). It also documents parallel execution with automatic coordination (restate-docs-50) and orchestrators that dynamically plan and dispatch tasks to workers (restate-docs-54). Durable sync/async service calls with exactly-once semantics (restate-docs-3, restate-docs-56) act as child-workflow invocations, and racing with cancellation (restate-docs-57) adds further composition options. Missing for 10: generic (non-AI) workflow docs for parallel and fan-out primitives, explicit child-workflow semantics, dynamic batch-size handling detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
